title: Remote connection
responsibility: Chooses connection controls appropriate to the current computer or phone environment.

inputs.name: RemoteConnection.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace state whose remote.host and remote.phone values select the panel when remote context stores are available. The host panel takes precedence if both values are truthy; without context stores, neither panel renders.

inputs.name: RemoteConnection.compact
inputs.description: Controls the compact mode passed to the selected host or phone panel. It defaults to false and has no effect when neither panel renders.

outputs.name: RemoteConnection
outputs.description: Renders the host panel with the host store when context stores and workspace.remote.host are truthy; otherwise it renders the phone panel with the phone store when context stores and workspace.remote.phone are truthy, or renders nothing. The host branch takes precedence when both remote values are truthy, and the compact value is forwarded to the rendered panel. Below the phone panel, where workspace.remote.phone.openVault exists, a Vault button calls it; a rejected call shows the error's message, or a fixed fallback, as an alert until the next attempt.
